[Verse 1]
[G#5]I went through the automatic
[C5]doors My shopping cart ran in to
[F5]hers Our eyes met for ase-
[D#5]cond, then she turned away
[G#5]And after just a little
[C5]while I went in to the canned
[F5]goods aisle And there she was just
[D#5]standing there smiling

[Chorus]
[C#5]I was hoping she'd look
[G#5]at me But
[C#5]she was checking out
[G#5]the lima beans
[C#5]And artichoke, my
[G#5]heart was broken in pie-
[D#5]ces By
my supermarket fantasy

[Verse 2]
[G#5]I didn't want to seem obses-
[C5]sed I checked Farina off my
[F5]list But I couldn't keep my
[D#5]mind off those perfect lips
[G#5]I saw her start to walk my
[C5]way Thought that everything would be
[F5]ok Then I ran
[D#5]in to the cocoa puffs display

[Chorus]
[C#5]I hurried to the
[G#5]checkout line
[C#5]Wishing I could push
[G#5]back time
[C#5]I looked around and
[G#5]she was right behind
[D#5]me

[C5]Up and down the empty
